text.en: Pet owners across North Phoenix express complete trust in Kristine for long-term cat sitting and special-occasion dog watching. Reviewers note that she is highly organised during busy events such as weddings and willingly assists with minor household chores while owners are away.

title.en: Dedicated care for dogs and cats

text.en: Clients highlight the attentive care provided to both cats and dogs during in-home visits in the Desert View area. One cat owner mentions relying on Kristine for over a decade, whilst others appreciate her genuine fondness for companion animals and the peace of mind she brings.

title.en: Daily photo updates and clear messages

text.en: Every reviewer praises the clear and consistent communication before and during pet sitting bookings. Owners value receiving daily photographs and written progress notes from home visits, which keeps them reassured whilst travelling or attending full-day family events.

q.en: Does PerPETual Love Pet Sitting send updates during visits?

a.en: Yes, clients mention receiving daily photographs and written updates while away from home.

q.en: Can the sitter care for both dogs and cats?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe multi-year in-home cat care as well as dog sitting for special events.

q.en: Does the service cover medication administration and nutrition?

a.en: Yes, the service offers in-home drop-in visits, dog walks, medication administration, and pet nutrition consultations.
